## What's changed

- Added an opt-in compact Tube TV guide window for Tater Tube Player so the
  player receives the current break plus the next four programs instead of the
  entire planned schedule.
- Preserved complete commercial and Tater-bumper sequences around the current
  guide position so Live TV cards continue to describe breaks correctly.
- Kept the existing full lineup response as the default, leaving retro players
  and older Tater Tube Player builds unchanged.
- Reduced guide transfer, parsing, and cache work to help controller navigation
  stay responsive while background content refreshes finish.
